Payout of 19 August is short ₹1,513.53.
The bank credited ₹32,909.04 against an expected ₹34,422.57. 3 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
